title: Contrasting Two Perspectives
grammar: Contrastive topicalization (ami X-et illeti, viszont, ezzel szemben)
goal: I can frame contrastive topics using 'ami X-et illeti', 'viszont', and 'ezzel szemben'.
I can combine a contrastive topic at the start of a clause with a narrow focus before the verb.
I can compare characters' public behavior with their inner feelings.
